# A component's function reading a prop bound to a loop variable, on every
# target a test can execute on: testdata/component_func_reads_loop_prop.txtar
# is the code.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output {
    go {
        bubbletea
        fyne
        gtk4
    }
    kotlin {
        android
    }
    none {
        html
    }
}

component row(label string) node {
    func shout() string {
        var out = ""
        for var c = [1, 2] {
            out = out + label + "{c}"
        }
        return out
    }
    text(value=shout())
}

component tagged(label string) node {
    func suffix(s string) string {
        return s + label
    }
    text(value=["q"].map(suffix)[0])
}

component main node {
    var shown = true
    var name = "n"
    vbox {
        button #hide(text="h", @click { shown = false })
        for var x = ["p", "q"] {
            row(label=x)
            tagged(label=x)
        }
        if shown {
            row #only(label=name)
        }
    }
}

func testRowsRender(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.only != null)
    c.hide.click()
    t.assert(c.only == null)
}

window {
    main
}
